items.reason: This area is pure rules plus the clip download; it keeps no database of its own. Update over older versions: routine rows saved before per-set plans keep no set list and read as before; a damaged saved set plan or focus block is dropped (existing finding); workouts saved before the routine link was stored are still placed in Today's rotation by name, then by shared exercises. Routine files: an older file opens, a file from a newer app is refused with 'Update the app'. Clips: file names carry the clip version and the cloud job only adds files to the release, never deletes, so an older app keeps finding its own version; a newer version replaces the old files on the phone after it arrives. Sideload vs Play: same clip address and same rules in both. Watch on another version: nothing in this area talks to the watch. Panel cache after deploy does not apply to the phone app.

App not opened for 6 months: the Target line cuts the weight by 10, 20 or 30 percent after a break of 6 weeks, 3 months or 6 months and says how many weeks it has been; timed exercises hold the time; the week card honestly reads 'usually none' against the last 8 weeks; the AI text says no workouts were logged. But a followed plan's week number and easy weeks count the calendar weeks away (existing finding). Changes phone: workouts brought back from the cloud copy lose their long-rest marks (existing finding). Year end and leap day: months and years are built from the day text, 'Last 12 months' uses one shared rule that handles 29 February, the year in review lists January to the last month and the January report compares with December. Trial end, plan end, gym pausing, staff leaving: no paid gate or gym link in this area.

New-only rules here: the goal-based rep range is given only to newly added routine rows (older rows keep 8 to 12); easy weeks start on only when a plan is followed or built after the feature; badges are worked out from every past workout, so existing members get theirs too.
Existing members have a path: the Rep range setting sets the range of every row, old ones too; any folder's menu has an Easy weeks on or off switch.
Rule applied: every new-only rule in this area has a path for existing members; no finding.

The only 'new' mark in this area is the finish screen's 'New badge' line, and it names only badges earned by the workout just finished, so a brand-new install sees it on its first real badge and an existing member never sees old badges marked new.
Rule applied: no new mark here lands on something that is not new to the member; no finding.
